question: Does exact FPMarketsSC-Live US10YR have attributable Treasury-note futures CFD identity, original 2023 warmup and 2024-2025 history, historical roll/adjustment and raw-clock authority sufficient for a separately declared independent rate-duration candidate?
prior_exposure: All previous Challenge closures and broad 2026 benchmark data are already known; no epistemic blindness is claimed.
A current broker product listing and search-indexed US10YR description are an unverified source lead.
Current English and localized rollover tables differ in displayed maturities; neither certifies 2023-2025 history.
No US10YR broker-native contract, historical price, timestamp, signal or economic response has been inspected before this declaration.

preparation.private_contents: Physical own copies only; ignored before copying; never print, publish or stage contents. Copy receipts remain private.
preparation.reader: One new hidden own Portable, Experts enabled=0, AllowLiveTrading=0, AllowDllImport=0, blank Expert/Script, maxbars=2000000. Explicit own terminal path and FPMarketsSC-Live initialization.
preparation.lifecycle: Host records exact own PID/path, starts hidden and normally closes that exact process after capture, pause or fault; API shutdown alone is insufficient. No forced kill and no closed-reader restart.

native_scope.matching_inventory: symbols_get(group=*US10YR*) is static identity metadata only; maximum 25 returned contracts. No matching alternative receives history.
native_scope.partition: Exactly 36 chronological calendar-month M1 requests, all symbols fixed to US10YR. Endpoints use timezone-aware UTC API arguments; retain only original raw integer timestamps in the half-open interval.
retained_outputs: counts, raw first/last timestamp, every observed raw date, gaps and API status per month
static instrument fields and exact acquisition provenance
native_scope.delivery_limit: The native API necessarily returns a structured OHLC/volume/spread payload and the platform may maintain private current/history caches. Only time is accessed by this producer; other fields are discarded without analysis or export. No 2026 historical request is made.
native_scope.clock: Preserve raw epochs and source-date integers without treating API UTC documentation as broker-wall/absolute-session proof. Do not shift, select, interpolate or forward-fill a favorable clock.
native_scope.coverage: Retain every requested month, including empty/partial coverage. Record monotonicity, minute grid and gaps without a hindsight date-admission filter. Monthly timestamp existence is not proof of continuous contracts or real-tick execution.
native_scope.stopping: Pause at a completed month for same-task V7R read-only readiness. Preserve completed hashes and resume own unit only. API, connection, capacity, serialization or chronology faults are attributable correction states without arbitrary retry caps, never strategy failures. RES_E_NOT_FOUND is only no history returned for that request, not universal broker absence.

primary_document_scope.search_scope: Inspect exact US10YR instrument, historical 2023-2025 rollover/adjustment, and clock statements on primary FP Markets pages. CME official Treasury-note contract specifications may establish underlying mechanics only, never the broker CFD lineage. Search-indexed text and regional redirects remain explicitly lower provenance than a native identity response.
bounded_questions: Does the exact native name exist and what is its own contract?
Which declared original months/dates are actually returned?
Is each historical old/new contract, effective switch time and price adjustment attributable without using future price responses?
Can the raw timestamp and intended external clock relation be established independently?
primary_document_scope.no_expansion: No paid data, broker message/contact, third-party numerical history, alternate instrument history, broad exchange data download or candidate price-response study. Follow primary references needed to resolve these four questions, then close the bounded source unit with explicit unresolved dimensions.

ready_requires: Exact native Treasury-note futures CFD identity established, not cash yield or maturity curve.
Declared warmup/development observations and all material coverage gaps attributable.
Historical contract switch and any adjustment semantics supported for the intended historical source.
Raw-clock authority sufficient for any intended external-time joining; API documentation and a current server convention are not silently equated.
readiness_rule.partial_or_unready: If the source record is operationally complete but a required dimension remains unresolved, report precisely what was observed and missing, close without a candidate or an economic failure verdict, and compare all Programs 1-5/7. A public-search failure is not proof that no such historical authority exists.
readiness_rule.no_automatic_successor: No GILT/FX/ETF substitution, yield conversion, AUDCHF pulse/repo-response model reuse, follow/fade variant, feature/return/fill/risk score, 2026 candidate data, EA/native, seed or Live action. Any future candidate needs a separate complete independent declaration after whole-map comparison.

storage.scope: Total new owned runtime and raw source output, conservatively checked against all remaining allowed growth before preparation and each month. Source evidence/code is small and also consumes free space.
storage.retention: Preserve all existing unique inputs, raw results, closed evidence, source and Live state; no cleanup is required.

goal: ACTIVE_INCOMPLETE; previous Goal turn made concrete progress through complete Family 014 closure and whole-map selection. This source question is a bounded next step within the full independent V8 Challenge, not a replacement Goal.
live: V7R read-only market check is a separate serial operating duty. The assistant never activates trading or changes new-entry authority; only the user directly performs any eventual trading activation.
